work.title: Extract StageRunService
work.description: Move start, resume, complete, return, attempt numbering, run identity, stage role binding, and handoff generation into StageRunService.
acceptance: StageRunService owns stage execution state but not GitHub publication
resume cannot alter role, model, harness, attempt, or todo
Stage transitions remain controlled by the Core lifecycle
Every stage continues to receive an isolated worktree
No stage automatically invokes the next stage
